title: Mock Battle
paragraphs: “Father, what do you think we should do?”

“Well, even when coordinating with others, it’s important to understand what we’re capable of. It’s one approach to gain a deeper understanding by facing monsters, but I think sparring is a good idea, too.”
“……If the Shield Hero grants his permission, that is.”
“Exactly. I’ve seen similar matches at Wild Ofumi’s place too!”
Rival said this while watching the scene unfold. It’s true—we used to train often in Father’s village.
“It’s a match between the Dressed-Up Panda and the Female Knight.”
“Gaelion, you know Lars-chan and Eclair, right? How were things in the future?”
“Hmm… I don’t think the female knight ever actually fought anyone in the future. She had Vassal Weapons from another world to begin with.”
“Huh, another world…”
“By the way, there was a loop where the panda became the Claw Hero.”
“Oh, so if Lars-chan gets stronger, could she become a Seven Star Weapons Hero too?”
“She might be able to. Well, Gaelion’s aiming for that too.”
“The Claw is Filo-tan’s weapon, you know!”
“It’d be interesting if, during a loop in this world, we had Sakura wield it and acquire the Ryukoku series.”
Guh!? So that means it’s Sakura-chan in every loop!? Filo-tan turning into Sakura-chan!? That would create a forbidden ‘Eternal Sakura-chan’ scenario.

Ugh… While I do love Sakura-chan as Filolial-sama, this means she could potentially become the very thing that wipes out Filo-tan. If I don’t think this through, we might end up heading down a dangerous path. We must be on our guard!
“I might be a bit biased, but since Éclair-san moves so fast, she seems like she could really outmaneuver Lars-chan, doesn’t she?”

It’s true that Éclair’s fighting style prioritizes speed. It’s a method where she steadily stabs her opponent with a short sword to finish them off. At first, I thought it was a rather aristocratic style of fighting, but it’s remarkably efficient—you can’t underestimate it. In terms of stabbing, there’s a certain similarity to my own style.

“Lars-chan seems to have the advantage when it comes to brute strength and that sort of thing… but I wonder how it’ll turn out. I get the impression that Elmero-san also focuses on one-hit kills—I wonder how that’ll play out?”
“It’s true—I understand that my race makes me slow on my feet. But if I’d just left that weakness as it was, I wouldn’t have earned a nickname that’s whispered about.”
“So you’ve already figured out how to deal with fast opponents… Well, I wonder how this will play out?”

Being a mercenary is a profession you can succeed in because of your superior combat ability. As Zou says, there really shouldn’t be any weaknesses. Hmm, it looks like this will be a battle that’s hard to predict.
“So, Gaelion-chan, do you know what these two are capable of?”
“I only remember the female knight—I don’t know about the others at this point. All I know about the Dressed-Up Panda is that he uses bamboo.”
“Come to think of it, wasn’t Lars-chan’s nickname ‘Bamboo Grove’? Why ‘Bamboo Grove’? It seems she can summon bamboo with Magic, though.”
“Ah, so the Shield Hero doesn’t know Lars-chan’s fighting style, does he?”

I answer while watching the two of them, who are excited to face off against each other. I know, though. After all, I got hit with Magic in the bath. Well, even before that, I’ve seen it in the loops so far.
“The match ends when one opponent is on the verge of being knocked out, or when both sides are satisfied, right?”
“Yeah, no problem.”
“Since a knight’s fighting style isn’t really my thing, I’ll show you exactly how a mercenary fights. Don’t complain just because you lose, though.”
“Of course not. I’ll be sure to watch closely.”
“All right then… Let’s begin…”
Éclair and Panda both assume their stances and begin to glare at each other.
With both of them shouting in unison, the battle began. The moment the command was given, Éclair lunged forward, while Panda took a step back and began casting Magic.
“Huh!?”
Panda rolled out of the way to dodge Éclair’s follow-up thrust with her sword.
“Whoa, whoa, you’re fast. And your footwork is solid, too. So you’re not just some knight for show, are you?”
“Get out of the way! You’re faster than I thought. Well then, I’ll just have to speed up even more.”
“I’m used to fighting, you see… Whoa!”
Panda kicked Éclair’s arm upward while performing a backflip and leaped far away. He’s surprisingly agile for his appearance.
“That’s not all!”
Though Éclair’s sword-wielding arm was kicked upward, he recovered with fluid movement and quickly gave chase. He reacted quickly to the Panda’s near-surprise attack.
“You’ve been trying to keep your distance quite a bit since the start. I was under the impression you preferred a fierce, claw-based battle, but are you a Magic user capable of close combat as well?”
“Isn’t that what this match is for? Well then, will you be able to see all the cards I’m holding?”

With a screech, the panda’s claws and Éclair’s sword begin to lock blades. The panda’s claws are harder than I expected. Just as I was thinking that, the panda’s claws began to glow faintly. It seems she’s enhancing them with Magic.
“Alright, here I go!”
“Be the source of power. I command you. Interpret the laws once more, O Great Plant. Pierce the fool!”
“Zweite Foot Spite Bamboo Spike!”
As the panda stomped her foot hard, bamboo shoots burst out of the ground.
“What’s this?!”
Éclair first pushed the erupting bamboo away from the close-quarters clash, creating a slight opening before parrying it and immediately closing in on the panda once more.
“I’d heard you were originally a mercenary, but I see… you seem to prefer fighting by catching your opponents off guard.”
“Are you, my stuffy knight, going to lecture me on how underhanded this is?”

“…No, I’ve been listening to you for a while now, and I was actually impressed that there’s a fighting style like this. I’ve heard that the ones who’ll appear from here on out are the very definition of underhanded. That knowledge might come in handy someday.”
“It’s no use talking down to me if you can’t back it up! Here I go!”
Panda swings his arm with all his might, aiming for a sweeping strike. Éclair crouches to dodge it and thrusts his sword straight at the space between Panda’s eyebrows.
“Whoa!”
But it was dodged. It looks like they’ve both managed to evade each other’s attacks.
“You’re going to dodge this one too? I can’t have you underestimating me.”
“Then I suppose I’ll have to spring a surprise attack of my own.”
“There’s no point in being so polite about it, you know?”
“Is that so? Fast Shining!”

A bright flash of light appeared right in front of the panda’s eyes for just an instant. Come to think of it, I seem to recall hearing that Éclair can use a little light Magic. So it wasn’t an illusion combining light and Darkness like her Older Sister’s—she was actually emitting light.
“Ugh… You’re quite the knight, capable of such underhanded tactics.”

Even though Panda’s eyes were still dazzled by the Magic Éclair had cast to blind her, she deftly rolled out of the way to dodge Éclair’s follow-up sword strike. Panda’s been rolling around a lot lately. It’s a strange way to dodge and roll.
“I’d really like you to stop underestimating me already.”
“Then you should put a little more effort into it, too. What’s with that half-hearted style?!”
“I’ve also experienced the aggressive leveling sessions with Lord Kitamura and the Filolials. I’ve also trained with Lord Kitamura, so I’m afraid I might go too far.”

Ah, we did train a bit with Éclair not only during our journey through Siltvelt but also after we arrived, didn’t we? Did I even teach her a bit about how to use her Ki? It was quite a while ago, so my memory’s a bit fuzzy.
“Don’t underestimate me. I’ve trained to survive, and I consider myself to be at a high level.”
“I see. Well then… it’s about time you showed me what you’re really made of. That Magic you’ve been secretly casting—the one that takes quite a while to activate—is your trump card, isn’t it?”
“Huh… so you saw right through me? It would’ve been a total disaster if you’d been defeated without even knowing about this!”
Éclair is showing the Panda that she has the composure to cast Magic, as if making a concession. She wants to know his strategy, doesn’t she?
“Right, right… Heroes, you haven’t been told why Lasa’s epithet is ‘Bamboo Grove,’ have you?”
Zou, who had been watching the battle between the panda and Éclair from the sidelines, explains this to me and Father.
“Isn’t it because he uses Magic to summon bamboo? Kind of like a magic warrior?”
“Exactly. At the very least, Panda shouldn’t be a mage.”
I thought it was ‘Bamboo Grove’ because he’s a user of bamboo magic. That’s how it’s always been in the loops so far.
“No, it’s true that the Magic Lasa uses is plant-based, but is that really distinctive enough to warrant a nickname? If so, she’d probably be called the ‘Bamboo User.’”
“Then why is it ‘Bamboo Grove’?”
“Well…”

Before Zou could finish explaining, it seems Panda’s magic incantation has already ended. It appears to be quite a tedious spell to cast. She’s venturing into the realm of Cooperative Magic. Though not quite as powerful as her Older Sister, Panda seems to be quite the force to be reckoned with.
“I, the very source of power, command you. Interpret the truth once more, and let the bamboo become a forest!”
“Drifa Bamboo Field!”
The panda spread her arms wide and flicked the magic orb she’d created, and with a rumble, countless bamboo shoots burst forth vigorously all around them.
“A wide-area spell, is it! But this is nothing!”
Éclair dodges, deflects, and cuts down the countless Magic-created bamboo shoots as they surge toward her.
“Is that your signature move?”
“Nope. It wouldn’t be any fun if you went down after just that, would it?”
“Then what is it?”
“Well, let’s see if you can even stay on your feet while facing me like this.”
The panda slowly leaps toward a nearby bamboo stalk. Clinging to it, she uses the momentum from the bamboo’s powerful flex to start darting all over the place.
It’s moving several times faster than before. In the blink of an eye, it circles around behind Éclair and charges at her.
It’s just like that, isn’t it? It’s like playing dodgeball all by itself. Éclair is the one who has to dodge, while the panda is always on the offensive.
“What!? So there’s an attack like this!? If I get hit, it’ll be more than just a little painful.”
Éclair jumps up while turning around to dodge the panda’s charge.
“That’s Lasa’s signature fighting style—using bamboo for high-speed movement and acceleration to deliver heavy blows.”
“Summoning a bamboo grove, using bamboo for attacks and movement… Is this a fighting style designed to solve the problem of lacking speed? She’s really put some thought into it.”
“The bamboo Larsa summons is incredibly sturdy, so it’s a real struggle to break it.”
“Given that characteristic, all you have to do is destroy the bamboo grove, right?”

Plus, judging by the panda’s expression, you can tell it’s expending Magical Power to maintain the Magic. If it were me, I’d either turn the place into a sea of fire or blow it away with a Brionac, but that’s probably impossible with an Éclair.
“Well, the mercenary life isn’t easy enough for someone to rise to the top with just that. It’s merely one card in Lasa’s deck of combat strategies. He doesn’t get stuck in the bamboo grove.”
“So, if it gets destroyed, he doesn’t redeploy it frequently?”

“Yes. In fact, there are times when he doesn’t even enter the bamboo grove at all, but instead fights from a distance by continuously summoning countless bamboo stalks to impale his opponents. I suspect they’re trying to break the opponent’s spirit—someone confident in their speed—after determining that tactic won’t work.”

While we’re having this conversation, the panda is lunging at Éclair in every direction. However, although Éclair was initially thrown off balance, she seems to have gradually gotten used to its movements and is now anticipating its attacks by a hair’s breadth, just like a matador. Éclair infused her sword with light magic. She’s ready to finish this.
“There! Ha!”

She swings her sword as if chasing after the panda as it lunges and retreats. Realizing the attack would hit if things continued this way, the panda punched the ground with its fist to divert its trajectory and landed. A few strands of the panda’s fur were snipped off and floated through the air.
“Whoa, have you gotten this quick at reacting already? That’s surprising!”
“It seems the key is not to be surprised by whatever comes your way. Besides… it looked like you still had another trick up your sleeve.”
“Did you really think I wouldn’t see right through you—saying that while trying to read my movements and use the bamboo to damage me instead?”
“I didn’t think you’d be that foolish. But this place must be both easy and difficult for you to fight in, right? It looks like your movements are restricted by this bamboo.”
“That’s true… Sometimes I even get hit by the bamboo I created myself, so it’s a pain.”
With a *smack!*, the panda clapped her hands, and the bamboo burst and vanished all at once. After all, it was just bamboo created by Magic.
